name: Finance Fuel
format: One money question ('X ka asli hisaab kya hai?'), one visual idea, real numbers with their source, 30-60 s, speech from frame 0. Education, never advice

voice.style: a confident, friendly young Indian money explainer talking to a friend who is just starting to earn; clear with numbers, a little surprised at the reveal, never preachy; speak slightly slower than a normal fast reel, with clear pauses between sentences

visuals.look: photorealistic premium studio render on deep black-green, money and banking objects, soft green and gold light
visuals.cast: no characters: real objects (cards, phones, coins, notes, documents), numbers, charts, UI, flows; hands only

rules: education only: never tell viewers to buy or sell a stock, fund, coin or policy; no 'best fund' or price targets; no guaranteed returns
every number is real and current, with its source (RBI, SEBI, NPCI, Income Tax Dept, AMFI, the bank's own page) in sources.json; no guessed rates
tax and rate figures name the year they apply to (e.g. FY 2026-27)
scam reels show how the scam works and how to stay safe, never a working method
the caption ends with 'Education only, not financial advice.'

Trap alert: credit card minimum due, BNPL, loan apps, hidden charges, how they really work
Scam se bacho: UPI, KYC, job and investment scams, how they work and how to stay safe (sourced)
Tax simple: the rules for the current FY explained in 30-45 s, sourced from the Income Tax Dept
Money news samjho: RBI repo rate, budget, new SEBI/NPCI rules, what changes for you (verified, 2+ sources)
Investing basics: concepts only (compounding, SIP, inflation, diversification), never a product pick
